_metadata.name: Quality Inspection Failure & Rework
_metadata.description: Simulates a 5% quality failure on a batch at final inspection, forcing a rework routing that immediately re-enters the queue and consumes bottleneck capacity.

events.notes: 40 pieces (5%) of ORD-112 failed final inspection due to surface finish tolerances. They must be re-run through the Grinder immediately, stealing capacity from the active queue.
